metanarrative_source: Georg supplied HyperNorm brief and prior authoring context;canonical remote lore reread deferred as documented in Return;no canon approval inferred

records.name: Cliff Cloudlink
records.biography_en: Cliff fitted his fictional thought-link after HyperNorm called connection a civic virtue. Hunky and Dory praised his enthusiasm. A dissonant card asked whether every incoming suggestion was his own. He now pauses before agreeing, though the antenna still makes him feel included.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Reception is excellent. Ownership of the thought remains provisional.

records.name: Nora Buffering
records.biography_en: Nora's thought-loop stalls whenever HyperNorm asks for immediate certainty. The Men in Black request faster answers. An ambiguous card suggested that a pause could belong to her. She has begun using the delay to notice which neighbours are being hurried too.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The answer is pending. Please stop submitting it.

records.name: Hugh Autocomplete
records.biography_en: Hugh enjoys how confidently his thought-button completes HyperNorm conversations. Hunky and Dory value the consistency. A dissonant card finished a sentence differently and made a neighbour laugh. He kept the result, despite being unable to claim he had intended it.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: His opinion arrived early. He is being briefed on it.

records.name: Alma Airgap
records.biography_en: Alma holds the loose plug as though HyperNorm might notice an absence of permission. The Men in Black have described silence as suspicious. A contradictory card asked her to listen to a real neighbour instead. The conversation was slow and surprisingly easy to follow.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: She has lost the connection. The room is still here.

records.name: Percy Pending
records.biography_en: Percy presses his external patch whenever HyperNorm announces better thought service. Hunky and Dory insist the interruption is progress. A dissonant card suggested leaving the button alone. He found several unfinished opinions survived perfectly well without being renewed.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The update is compulsory. Improvement is a separate question.

records.name: Zen Unplugged
records.biography_en: Zen unplugged on the HyperNorm landing because he could not tell attention from reception. The Men in Black have requested a reason. He is still considering one. An ambiguous card became a conversation with the neighbour beside him, neither of whom checked if it had reached anyone else.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Nobody has acknowledged the moment. It appears to be happening anyway.
